case_schema.name: oct19-place-corrected
case_schema.request: absolute path to a hash-verified offline planner_request.json

requirements: Preserve original source hashes; path-remapped offline requests require separate derived hashes and provenance.
Bind all model, mesh, calibration and scene dependencies, not only the two mandatory model files.
Use independent output directory and offline_sandbox.sh; do not use a September proxy as an October reproduction.
Do not expect every INVALID_START_COLLISION case to become SUCCESS.
